summary: Safe, fun games for kids age 3-7.  Baby care, nursery & babysitting role play.
description:
STORIES JUNIOR GAMES
Gentle pretend play worlds for curious young minds.
Loved by over 300 million families worldwide and awarded for more than a decade, Stories Junior pretend play games invites children to imagine, create, and explore gentle family worlds filled with creativity and care to build their own stories.
Each playhouse is designed for open-ended discovery, where children lead the story, express emotions, and build empathy through imaginative role play.
Every space encourages curiosity, storytelling, and calm exploration in a safe digital environment made for kids in their early childhood.

STORIES JUNIOR: DAYCARE
A happy daycare full of stories to create.
Stories Junior: Daycare (previously Happy Daycare Stories) is the first title in the acclaimed Stories Junior franchise, inviting kids to explore a lively playhouse where every activity inspires imaginative role play in an open-ended daycare simulation.
Children can care for babies and toddlers, dress up characters, prepare meals, and create their own daycare adventures at their own rhythm in this playhouse.

EXPLORE THE DAYCARE
Playground – Swings, a pool, and joyful outdoor surprises.
Playroom – Toys and objects that spark imagination and creative role play.
Kitchen – Cook, share, and enjoy family moments.
Stage – Dress up, play music, and perform together.
Bedroom – Create calm routines before bedtime.
Bathroom – Learn care and responsibility through play.
Backyard – Enjoy a sunny picnic and open-air fun.

CHARACTERS FULL OF HEART
Five unique characters invite kids to create gentle family stories and pretend play different social activities.
Feed, bathe, dress, and care for babies and toddlers—each action helps nurture imagination, empathy, and emotional learning.

CREATED FOR PEACEFUL PLAY
• Designed for children ages 2–5 to explore safely and independently.
• Private, single-player experience with no chats or online features.
• Works perfectly offline once installed.

EXPAND YOUR DAYCARE STORIES
Stories Junior: Daycare is free to download and includes a rich playhouse with several rooms and activities ready to explore.
Families can expand the Daycare at any time with a single, safe purchase - make the daycare world even better with new stories to explore..

WHY FAMILIES LOVE STORIES JUNIOR
Families around the world trust Stories Junior for calm, creative pretend play that supports imagination and emotional growth.
Each title offers a gentle toy box world experience where children can explore family life, storytelling, and empathy at their own pace.
Stories Junior — Calm, creative play for growing minds.
